s01-01-story-f1545f.wav.text: The word of the LORD came to a prophet named Jonah.

s01-02-grave-ad1b3e.wav.text: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and call out against it, for their evil has come up before me.

s01-03-story-5dd28b.wav.text: Nineveh was the capital of Assyria, the cruellest empire of its day, and Israel's enemy.

s02-02-story-7fe51e.wav.text: He got on a ship going the opposite way, as far from Nineveh as he could get.

s02-03-story-f2d658.wav.text: So God sent a great storm.

s02-04-story-e9e0f4.wav.text: The sailors were terrified, and every one of them prayed to his own god.

s02-07-story-07fca1.wav.text: Throw me into the sea, and it will be calm.

s03-02-story-a8cd86.wav.text: And there, inside the fish, Jonah prayed.

s03-03-story-30f10d.wav.text: He thanked God for saving his life.

s03-05-story-f16d15.wav.text: And the fish spat him out onto dry land.

s04-01-story-56188e.wav.text: So God spoke to Jonah a second time. And this time, he went.

s04-04-story-d0d844.wav.text: From the king down, they stopped their violence and turned to God.
